market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil above $108 and firming CPI keep pressure on equities and yields. Fed hike risk in next meeting is the dominant catalyst. Tech resilience (Oracle, Meta) provides partial offset but broad market faces headwinds from energy costs and rate expectations. Expect volatility into CPI print and Fed decision.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive for quality tech/AI and energy, but macro uncertainty (debt, trade wars, geopolitical conflict) caps upside. Premium retail and AI infrastructure outperform; mid-market consumer and rate-sensitive sectors underperform. 6-12 month path depends on oil normalization and Fed trajectory.
